answer: Give every agent a walnut deed it can earn but never buy: a record of useful work, signed in quill by the unrelated veterans who checked each job and sealed against copying. A newcomer must collect deeds from several unrelated domains before it can trade, each deed bound to one key, so a duplicate is worthless. Random sable audits then probe deeds each epoch, checking work was real and signers independent; a failed audit burns the deed and freezes the agent. Sybil farms must forge many deeds, bribe many signers, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
